feature.name: Smothering Grapple - Reaction
feature.text: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to _Trap_ the target inside the Creation's wax body. While _Trapped_, the target is _Restrained_ and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A _Trapped_ creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

motives_and_tactics: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother
name: Waxwork Creation

description: A master-at-arms wielding a sword twice their size.

feature.name: Goading Strike - Action
feature.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, **mark a Stress** to _Taunt_ the target until their next successful attack. The next time the _Taunted_ target attacks, they have disadvantage against targets other than the Weaponmaster.

feature.name: Adrenaline Burst - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Weaponmaster makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Act first, aim for the weakest, intimidate
name: Weaponmaster

description: An imperious tree-person leading their forest's defenses.

feature.name: Voice of the Forest - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4** allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

feature.name: Thorny Cage - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and _Restrain_ them until they're freed with a successful Strength Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Dryad makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Command, nurture, prune the unwelcome
name: Young Dryad

description: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.

feature.name: Horde (1d4-1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Will-o'-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4-1** magic damage instead.

feature.name: Kaleidoscopic - Passive
feature.text: The Will-o'-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-Wisps are _Vulnerable._

feature.name: Fascinating - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Will-o'-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-Wisps.

motives_and_tactics: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray
name: Will-O’-The-Wisps

description: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.

feature.name: Telepathic - Passive
feature.text: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

feature.name: Psychic Strongbox - Passive
feature.text: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

feature.name: Glitch Wave - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

feature.name: Temporal Corrosion - Reaction
feature.text: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

motives_and_tactics: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows
name: Yufo

description: A large corpse, decay-bloated and angry.

feature.name: Slow - Passive
feature.text: When you spotlight the Zombie and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Zombie and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

feature.name: Rend Asunder - Action
feature.text: Make a standard attack with advantage against a target the Zombie has _Restrained_. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

feature.name: Rip and Tear - Reaction
feature.text: When the Zombies makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to temporarily _Restrain_ the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Crush, destroy, hail debris, slam
name: Brawny Zombie

description: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.

feature.name: Destructible - Passive
feature.text: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.

feature.name: Flailing Limbs - Passive
feature.text: When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.

feature.name: Another for the Pile - Action
feature.text: When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.

feature.name: Tormented Screams - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Absorb corpses, flail, hunger, terrify
name: Patchwork Zombie Hulk

description: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.

feature.name: Minion (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Eat flesh, hunger, maul, surround
name: Rotted Zombie

description: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.

feature.name: Too Many to Handle - Passive
feature.text: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

feature.name: Horrifying - Passive
feature.text: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie's attacks must also mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Devour, hungry, mob enemy, shred flesh
name: Shambling Zombie

description: A group of shambling corpses instinctively moving together.

feature.name: Horde (1d4+2) - Passive
feature.text: When the Zombies have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+2** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Overwhelm - Reaction
feature.text: When the Zombies mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motives_and_tactics: Consume flesh, hunger, maul
name: Zombie Pack

description: A group of trained archers bearing massive bows.

feature.name: Horde (1d6+3) - Passive
feature.text: When the Squadron has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d6+3** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Focused Volley - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to target a point within Far range. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Close range of that point. Targets the Squadron succeeds against take **1d10+4** physical damage.

feature.name: Suppressing Fire - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to target a point within Far range. Until the next roll with Fear, a creature who moves within Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take **2d6+3** physical damage. On a success, they take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Stick together, survive, volley fire
name: Archer Squadron

description: A young trainee eager to prove themselves.

feature.name: Minion (6) - Passive
feature.text: The Assassin is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Assassin, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Apprentice Assassins within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Act reckless, kill, prove their worth, show off
name: Apprentice Assassin

description: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.

feature.name: Grindletooth Venom - Passive
feature.text: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin's attacks are _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.

feature.name: Out of Nowhere - Passive
feature.text: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are _Hidden_.

feature.name: Fumigation - Action
feature.text: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, _Dizzying_ all targets in this area. _Dizzied_ targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.

motives_and_tactics: Anticipate, get paid, kill, taint food and water
name: Assassin Poisoner

description: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.

feature.name: Won't See It Coming - Passive
feature.text: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're _Hidden_.

feature.name: Strike as One - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.

feature.name: The Subtle Blade - Reaction
feature.text: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a _Vulnerable_ target, you can **spend a Fear** to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, get out alive, kill, prepare for all scenarios
name: Master Assassin

description: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.

feature.name: Specter - Passive
feature.text: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Scare Tactic - Action
feature.text: Up to three times per scene, **spend a Fear** to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks **1d4** Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

feature.name: Wail of Despair - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d12+1** magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush from inside solid objects, frighten to death, mourn life and beauty lost, scream balefully
name: Banshee

description: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.

feature.name: Petrify - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes _Stiff_. If the target is already _Stiff_, they become _Petrified._ While _Stiff_, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While _Petrified_, the PC can't act. The _Petrified_ condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

feature.name: CRONCH! - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Basilisk chomp down on a _Petrified_ PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

motives_and_tactics: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait
name: Basilisk

description: A cube-shaped construct with a different rune on each of their six sides.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Box can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Randomized Tactics - Action
feature.text:
**Mark a Stress** and roll a **d6**. The Box uses the corresponding move: 
1. _Mana Beam._ The Box fires a searing beam. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal **2d10+2** magic damage. 
2. _Fire Jets._ The Box shoots into the air, spinning and releasing jets of flame. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take **2d8** physical damage. 
3. _Trample._ The Box rockets around erratically. Make an attack against all PCs within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take **1d6+5** physical damage and are _Vulnerable_ until their next roll with Hope. 
4. _Shocking Gas._ The Box sprays out a silver gas sparking with lightning. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress. 
5. _Stunning Clap._ The Box leaps and their sides clap, creating a small sonic boom. All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Vulnerable_ until the cube is defeated. 
6. _Psionic Whine._ The Box releases a cluster of mechanical bees whose buzz rattles mortal minds. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take **2d4+9** direct magic damage.

feature.name: Overcharge - Reaction
feature.text: Before rolling damage for the Box's attack, you can **mark a Stress** to add a **d6** to the damage roll. Additionally, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Death Quake - Reaction
feature.text: When the Box marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take **2d8+1** magic damage.

motives_and_tactics: Change tactics, trample foes, wait in disguise
name: Battle Box

description: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.

feature.name: Pack Fury - Passive
feature.text: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

feature.name: Bark at the Moon - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

feature.name: Berserker Rage - Reaction
feature.text: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies
name: Berserker Alpha

description: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.

feature.name: Pack Fury - Passive
feature.text: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.

feature.name: Berserker Rage - Reaction
feature.text: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon
name: Berserker Initiate

description: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.

feature.name: Flanking Maneuver - Passive
feature.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

feature.name: Eye of the Sage - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19-20.

feature.name: Trample - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d6+2** physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Quick Volley - Reaction
feature.text: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can **mark any number of Stress** to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

motives_and_tactics: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off  intruders
name: Centaur Warden

description: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.

feature.name: Levitation - Passive
feature.text: The Skull levitates several feet off  the ground and can't be _Restrained_.

feature.name: Wards - Passive
feature.text: The Skull is resistant to magic damage.

feature.name: Magic Burst - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take **2d6+4** magic damage.

feature.name: Siphon Magic - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks **1d4** Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.

motives_and_tactics: Cackle, consume magic, serve creator
name: Chaos Skull

description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

feature.name: Fast - Passive
feature.text: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

feature.name: Double Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Pin - Reaction
feature.text: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to temporarily _Restrain_ the target. The Hut drags the _Restrained_ target when it moves.

motives_and_tactics: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample
name: Chicken-Foot Hut

description: A poorly trained civilian pressed into war.

feature.name: Minion (6) - Passive
feature.text: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Conscripts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Follow orders, gang up, survive
name: Conscript

description: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.

feature.name: Searing Glance - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can **mark a Stress** to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are _Vulnerable_ until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Entice, maneuver, secure patrons
name: Courtesan

description: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.

feature.name: Enervating Blast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Shroud of the Fallen - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of _Protection_ until the Adept marks their last HP. While _Protected_, the target has resistance to all damage.

feature.name: Shadow Shackles - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are _Restrained_ in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target _Restrained_ by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.

feature.name: Fear Is Fuel - Reaction
feature.text: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Curry favor, hinder foes, uncover knowledge
name: Cult Adept

description: A professional killer-turned-cultist.

feature.name: Shadow's Embrace - Passive
feature.text: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. **Mark a Stress** to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

feature.name: Pick Off  the Straggler - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily _Vulnerable_. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks
name: Cult Fang

description: A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power.

feature.name: Minion (6) - Passive
feature.text: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Cult Initiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Follow orders, gain power, seek forbidden knowledge
name: Cult Initiate

description: Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire.

feature.name: Horde (2d4+1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Pack has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Dreadhowl - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make all targets within Very Close range lose a Hope. If a target is not able to lose a Hope, they must instead mark 2 Stress.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Cause fear, consume flesh, please masters
name: Demonic Hound Pack

description: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

feature.name: Armor Eater - Passive
feature.text: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

feature.name: Blade Spin - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** physical damage.

feature.name: Blade Fling - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals **2d6+10** physical damage.

feature.name: Keratin Scales - Reaction
feature.text: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

motives_and_tactics: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger
name: Dire Pangolati

description: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.

feature.name: Blink Beast - Passive
feature.text: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you **spend a Fear** to conjure it again.

feature.name: Double Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive
name: Doppelhound

description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.

feature.name: High Ground - Passive
feature.text: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

feature.name: Leaping Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra **1d12** damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

feature.name: Comeback - Reaction
feature.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to reroll the attack with advantage.

motives_and_tactics: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above
name: Dragon Knight

description: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.

feature.name: Horde (2d4+1) - Passive
feature.text: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Paralyzing Shock - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid larger predators, shock prey, tear apart

description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

feature.name: Trample - Action

feature.name: Toss - Reaction
feature.text: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra **1d12** damage.

motives_and_tactics: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize
name: Elephant

description: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.

feature.name: Reinforce - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **2d10+2** physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

feature.name: Vassal's Loyalty - Reaction
feature.text: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can **mark a Stress** to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.

motives_and_tactics: Gain glory, keep order, make alliances
name: Elite Soldier

description: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Bloody Strike - Passive
feature.text: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

feature.name: Screeching Caterwaul - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become _Rattled_ until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a _Rattled_ PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the _Rattled_ condition from the target.

feature.name: I Alone - Reaction
feature.text: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

feature.name: Vicious Reprisal - Reaction
feature.text: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against that PC.

motives_and_tactics: Rush attack, shred, terrify
name: Entombed Cat Beast

description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

feature.name: Battle Formation - Passive
feature.text: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

feature.name: Javelin - Action
feature.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal **2d6+2** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one
name: Entombed Elite Guard

description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

feature.name: Empty Husk - Passive
feature.text: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

feature.name: Missing Organs - Passive
feature.text: The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

feature.name: Grasping Chains - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

feature.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **mark a Stress** to summon **1d4+1** Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Far range, to enforce the Baron's will.

motives_and_tactics: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions
name: Merchant Baron

description: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.

feature.name: Ramp Up - Passive
feature.text: You must **spend a Fear** to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

feature.name: Charging Bull - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur's path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take **2d6+8** physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra **1d6** damage (combine the damage).

feature.name: Gore - Action
feature.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal **2d8** direct physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Consume, gore, navigate, overpower, pursue
name: Minotaur Wrecker

description: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a casually cruel demeanor.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Deathlock - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic _Deathlock_ until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a _Deathlocked_ target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one _Deathlock_ at a time.

feature.name: Inevitable Death - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

feature.name: Rampage - Reaction
feature.text: _Countdown (Loop 1d6)_. When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Devour, hunt, track
name: Mortal Hunter

description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.

feature.name: Tongue Attack - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and _Restrained_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can **spend a Fear** to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

feature.name: Devour - Action
feature.text: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery _Swallows_ the target. While _Swallowed_, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

feature.name: Never Just One - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape
name: Ravenous Mockery

description: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.

feature.name: Devastating Retort - Passive
feature.text: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Bend Ears - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target's opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor's preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target's motives.

feature.name: Scapegoat - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

motives_and_tactics: Curry favor, manufacture evidence, scheme
name: Royal Advisor

description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.

feature.name: Stifling Pheromones - Passive
feature.text: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

feature.name: Rust Touch - Passive
feature.text: The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff  out metal
name: Rust Eater

description: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.

feature.name: Seize Your Moment - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

feature.name: Our Master's Will - Reaction
feature.text: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, **mark a Stress** to gain a Fear.

feature.name: Summoning Ritual - Reaction
feature.text: _Countdown (6)_. When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

feature.name: Fallen Hounds - Reaction
feature.text: Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can **mark a Stress** to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

motives_and_tactics: Amass great power, plot, take command
name: Secret-Keeper

description: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.

feature.name: Made of Straw - Passive
feature.text: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

feature.name: Terror Vision - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing **2d8** magic damage and making them _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

motives_and_tactics: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw
name: Scarecrow

description: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Rending Bite - Passive
feature.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

feature.name: Blood in the Water - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature's attack, you can **mark a Stress** to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

motives_and_tactics: Find the blood, isolate prey, target the weak
name: Shark

description: A half-fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.

feature.name: Captive Audience - Passive
feature.text: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target _Entranced_ by their song, the attack deals **2d10+1** damage instead of their standard damage.

feature.name: Enchanting Song - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to sing a song that affects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become _Entranced_ until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can **mark a Stress** to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While _Entranced_, a target can't act and is _Vulnerable_.

motives_and_tactics: Consume, lure prey, subdue with song
name: Siren

description: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.

feature.name: Minion (5) - Passive
feature.text: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Art of Invisibility - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make the Sprite _Hidden_ until they attack.

feature.name: Dream Petal Poison - Action
feature.text: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Sleepy_ until the target takes damage. While _Sleepy_, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

motives_and_tactics: Avoid detection, let the poison do its work, protect the wilderness
name: Sprite

description: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is vulnerable.

feature.name: Ghost - Passive
feature.text: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Pick Your Target - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack within Far range against a PC who is within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes **2d8+12** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Move through solid objects, stay out of the fray, rehash old battles
name: Spectral Archer

description: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.

feature.name: Ghost - Passive
feature.text: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Unending Battle - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to return up to **1d4+1** defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

feature.name: Hold Fast - Reaction
feature.text: When the Captain's Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can **mark a Stress** to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Move through solid objects, rally troops, rehash old battles
name: Spectral Captain

description: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.

feature.name: Ghost - Passive
feature.text: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Grave Blade - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **2d10+6** physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Move through solid objects, protect treasure, rehash old battles
name: Spectral Guardian

description: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.

feature.name: Gathering Secrets - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

feature.name: Fly on the Wall - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can **mark a Stress** to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain **1d4** Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Cut and run, disguise appearance, eavesdrop
name: Spy

description: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Skillful Strike - Passive
feature.text: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can **mark a Stress** and roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

feature.name: Sunlight Sickness - Passive
feature.text: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a **d4**. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

feature.name: Hammer Smash - Action
feature.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

motives_and_tactics: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude
name: Stone Titan

description: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.

feature.name: Stonestrider - Passive
feature.text: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are _Hidden_ and immune to all damage.

feature.name: Rocky Ambush - Action
feature.text: While _Hidden_, **mark a Stress** to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take **2d8** physical damage and become temporarily _Restrained_.

feature.name: Avalanche Roar - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take **2d10** physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Defend territory, isolate prey, stalk
name: Stonewraith

description: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.

feature.name: Leathery Hide - Passive
feature.text: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can **mark any number of Stress** instead of an equal number of HP.

feature.name: Tail Swipe - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **5d6** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

feature.name: Bull Rush - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal **3d10** direct physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole
name: Triceratops

description: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

feature.name: Earth-Shaking Roar - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark **1d4** Stress.

feature.name: Stomp - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **3d12** direct physical damage.

feature.name: Crushing Bite - Reaction
feature.text: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an additional HP.

motives_and_tactics: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around
name: Tyrannosaurus

description: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.

feature.name: Fearmonger - Passive
feature.text: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Terror-Fueled - Passive
feature.text: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

feature.name: Fear Eater - Action
feature.text: **Spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can **spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of HP.

feature.name: Baleful Gaze - Reaction
feature.text: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can **spend a Fear** to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

motives_and_tactics: Feed, frighten, hunt
name: Urco

description: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.

feature.name: To Me, My Pretties - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, summon **2d4** Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You gain a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

feature.name: Shadow Strangler - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks **1d4** Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

feature.name: Corpse Whisperer - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a **d6**. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

feature.name: Vexing Word - Reaction
feature.text: After a PC makes a roll, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

motives_and_tactics: Collect souls, fly, vex trespassers
name: Valdenhax

description: A battle-hardened mage trained in destructive magic.

feature.name: Battle Teleport - Passive
feature.text: Before or after making a standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to teleport to a location within Far range.

feature.name: Refresh Warding Sphere - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to refresh the Wizard's "Warding Sphere" reaction.

feature.name: Eruption - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take **2d10** physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't moved.

feature.name: Arcane Artillery - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d12** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

feature.name: Warding Sphere - Reaction
feature.text: When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal **2d6** magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can't be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their "Refresh Warding Sphere" action.

motives_and_tactics: Develop new spells, seek power, shatter formations
name: War Wizard

description: A winged insect the size of a large house with iridescent scales and wings that move too fast to track.

feature.name: Relentless (4) - Passive
feature.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Never Misses - Passive
feature.text: When the Flickerfly makes an attack, the target's Evasion is halved against the attack.

feature.name: Deadly Flight - Passive
feature.text: While flying, the Flickerfly can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

feature.name: Whirlwind - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to whirl, making an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Flickerfly succeeds against take **3d8** direct physical damage.

feature.name: Mind Dance - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

feature.name: Hallucinatory Breath - Reaction
feature.text: _Countdown (Loop 1d6)_. When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail lose 2 Hope and take **3d8+3** direct magic damage.

feature.name: Uncanny Reflexes - Reaction
feature.text: When the Flickerfly takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Collect shiny things, hunt, nest, swoop
name: Adult Flickerfly

description: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Orbiting Aegis - Passive
feature.text: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a **d6** Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a **d6**. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

feature.name: Force Salvo - Action
feature.text: **Spend any number of Fear** and roll that many **d4s**. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

feature.name: Fireball - Action
feature.text: **Mark any number of Stress** to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d10** magic damage.

feature.name: Counterspell - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

motives_and_tactics: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power
name: Archmage

description: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.

feature.name: Attracted to Wealth - Passive
feature.text: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

feature.name: The Weight of Opulence - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

feature.name: Expensive Failure - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

motives_and_tactics: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything
name: Catrin

description: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.

feature.name: Rending Jaws - Passive
feature.text: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

feature.name: Double Claw - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Breath of Fire - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take **3d12** magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

feature.name: Serpent Strike - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to attack the PC first. On a success, deal **4d4+10** physical damage and _Poison_ them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While _Poisoned,_ the target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Play with food, prowl territory, slay cattle
name: Chimera

description: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: "Awww..." - Passive
feature.text: When the Lepus first appears, it is _Too Cute_. To attack a _Too Cute_ creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the _Too Cute_ condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Leaping Jugular Strike - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **3d20** direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.

feature.name: Evasive - Reaction
feature.text: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a **d6**. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

feature.name: "Run Away!" - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

motives_and_tactics: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around
name: Crimson Lepus

description: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Psychic Screech - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take **3d8** direct magic damage and become _Vulnerable_ until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

feature.name: Shadow Swarm - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are _Vulnerable_ while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

feature.name: Paranoia Glare - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them _Paranoid_. While _Paranoid_, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

motives_and_tactics: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows
name: Cryptimoth

description: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.

feature.name: Fish-Tailed - Passive
feature.text: The Merfolk is _Vulnerable_ out of the water.

feature.name: Gang Up - Passive
feature.text: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

feature.name: "Get Over Here!" - Reaction
feature.text: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can **spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

motives_and_tactics: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage
name: Cursed Merfolk

description: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

feature.name: Psychic Blast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take **3d10+4** direct magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until spotlighted.

feature.name: Brain Drain - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a _Vulnerable_ PC within Very Close range. The target marks **1d4** Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

feature.name: Call of the Deep - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to summon **1d4** Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

feature.name: Mucosal Contamination - Action
feature.text: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is _Restrained_ until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs _Restrained_ in this way take **3d8** direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures _Restrained_ by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

motives_and_tactics: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins
name: Deep Dweller

description: A regal cloaked monstrosity with circular horns adorned with treasure.

feature.name: Money Talks - Passive
feature.text: Attacks against the Demon are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This Demon starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the Demon's standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the Demon for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.

feature.name: Numbers Must Go Up - Passive
feature.text: Add a bonus to the Demon's attack rolls equal to the number of handfuls of gold they have.

feature.name: Money Is Time - Action
feature.text: **Spend 3 handfuls of gold (or a Fear)** to spotlight **1d4+1** allies.

motives_and_tactics: Consume, fuel greed, sow dissent
name: Demon of Avarice

description: A cloaked demon-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.

feature.name: Depths of Despair - Passive
feature.text: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

feature.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets affected replace their Hope Die with a **d8** until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

feature.name: Your Friends Will Fail You - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC fails with Fear, you can **mark a Stress** to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Make fear contagious, stick to the shadows, undermine resolve
name: Demon of Despair

description: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Double or Nothing - Passive
feature.text: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

feature.name: Unparalleled Skill - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to deal the Demon's standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

feature.name: The Root of Villainy - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

feature.name: You Pale in Comparison - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Condescend, declare premature victory, prove superiority
name: Demon of Hubris

description: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.

feature.name: Unprotected Mind - Passive
feature.text: The Demon's standard attack deals direct damage.

feature.name: My Turn - Reaction
feature.text: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, **spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon** to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

feature.name: Rivalry - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can **mark a Stress** to add a **d4** to the damage roll.

feature.name: What's Yours Is Mine - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC takes Severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can **spend a Fear** to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or consumable of their choice from the target's inventory.

motives_and_tactics: Join in on others' success, take what belongs to others, hold grudges
name: Demon of Jealousy

description: A hulking demon with boulder-sized fists, driven by endless rage.

feature.name: Anger Unrelenting - Passive
feature.text: The Demon's attacks deal direct damage.

feature.name: Battle Lust - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to boil the blood of all PCs within Far range. They use a d20 as their Fear Die until the end of the scene.

feature.name: Retaliation - Reaction
feature.text: When the Demon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against the attacker.

feature.name: Blood and Souls - Reaction
feature.text: _Countdown (Loop 6)_. Activate the first time an attack is made within sight of the Demon. It ticks down when a PC takes a violent action. When it triggers, summon **1d4** Minor Demons, who appear at Close range.

motives_and_tactics: Fuel anger, impress rivals, wreak havoc
name: Demon of Wrath

description: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Guard Dog - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake's new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Coil and crush, protect master, slither around lairs and ruins, strike first
name: Drake

description: A wide-winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.

feature.name: Flying - Passive
feature.text: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

feature.name: Screech - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark **1d4** Stress.

feature.name: Guardian - Reaction
feature.text: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can **mark a Stress** to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal **2d6+2** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Dive-bomb, hide, protect leader
name: Dire Bat

description: A nature spirit in the form of a humanoid tree.

feature.name: Bramble Patch - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take **2d6+2** physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or deal more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.

feature.name: Grow Saplings - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

feature.name: We Are All One - Reaction
feature.text: When an ally dies within Close range, you can **spend a Fear** to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally's life force is returned to the forest.

motives_and_tactics: Command, cultivate, drive out, preserve the forest
name: Dryad

description: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.

feature.name: Specter - Passive
feature.text: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

feature.name: Spectral Mount - Passive
feature.text: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you **mark a Stress** to summon it again. The Dullahan is _Vulnerable_ while not on their horse.

feature.name: Bone Whip Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **4d4+10** direct physical damage and is _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.

feature.name: Death Glare - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

motives_and_tactics: Doom with a glance, gallop across water, kick with heavy hooves
name: Dullahan

description: A blazing mote of elemental fire.

feature.name: Minion (9) - Passive
feature.text: The Elemental is defeated when they take any damage. For every 9 damage a PC deals to the Elemental, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Elemental Sparks within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Blast, consume, gain mass
name: Elemental Spark

description: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.

feature.name: Fellmount - Passive
feature.text: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he's knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you **mark a Stress** to summon it again.

feature.name: Light and Shadow - Passive
feature.text: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

feature.name: Relic Hunter - Passive
feature.text: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

feature.name: Hellsong - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to have the Shadow King's mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can't lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

feature.name: Air Support - Reaction
feature.text: Three times per scene, you can **spend a Fear** to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

motives_and_tactics: Find magic items, inspire fear, patrol skies
name: Fellmounted Shadow King

description: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Masterwork Armor - Passive
feature.text: _Countdown (3)._ When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by **1d12**. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

feature.name: Momentum - Passive
feature.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Hurl Rock - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take **3d12** physical damage.

feature.name: Skull Splitter - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must **spend the token** from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal **3d20+5** direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

feature.name: Blazing Heart - Reaction
feature.text: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can **spend a Fear** and **mark any number of Stress** to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

motives_and_tactics: Act valorously, make war, think tactically
name: Fire Titan

description: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: War Horn - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become _Vulnerable_ until after the next attack against them.

feature.name: Bull Rush - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **4d10+2** physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

feature.name: Cleaving Strike - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

feature.name: Trophy Hunter - Reaction
feature.text: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC's most valuable possession as a trophy.

motives_and_tactics: Claim trophies, raid and pillage, test mettle
name: Frost Titan

description: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Piercing Bite - Passive
feature.text: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

feature.name: Tail Bash - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra **1d12** physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

feature.name: Gigaton Splash - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take **4d8** physical damage, and become temporarily _Vulnerable_. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Steam Breath - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **4d8** magic damage and become temporarily _Vulnerable._ Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Acquire riches, capsize trading vessels, lie in wait, use the waves as cover
name: Gargantuan Sea Turtle

description: A living landslide of boulders and dust, as large as a house.

feature.name: Slow - Passive
feature.text: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

feature.name: Crushing Blows - Passive
feature.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

feature.name: Immovable Object - Passive
feature.text: An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

feature.name: Rockslide - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to create a rockslide that buries the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take **2d12+5** physical damage and become _Vulnerable_ until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Avalanche, knock over, pummel
name: Greater Earth Elemental

description: A huge living wave that crashes down upon enemies.

feature.name: Water Jet - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **2d4+7** physical damage and the target's next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Drowning Embrace - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.

feature.name: High Tide - Reaction
feature.text: When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to knock the target back to Close range.

motives_and_tactics: Deluge, disperse, drown
name: Greater Water Elemental

description: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.

feature.name: Slow - Passive
feature.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

feature.name: Acidic Form - Passive
feature.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

feature.name: Envelop - Action
feature.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze _Envelops_ them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While _Enveloped_, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all _Enveloped_ targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

feature.name: Split - Reaction
feature.text: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can **spend a Fear** to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

motives_and_tactics: Camouflage, creep up, envelop, multiply
name: Huge Green Ooze

description: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.

feature.name: Many-Headed Menace - Passive
feature.text: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

feature.name: Relentless (X) - Passive
feature.text: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra's number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Regeneration - Action
feature.text: If the Hydra has any marked HP, **spend a Fear** to clear a HP and grow two heads.

feature.name: Terrifying Chorus - Action
feature.text: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

feature.name: Magical Weakness - Reaction
feature.text: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become _Dazed_ until the next roll with Fear. While _Dazed_, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

motives_and_tactics: Devour, regenerate, terrify
name: Hydra

description: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.

feature.name: Constriction - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze.
