The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become _Constricted_ until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While _Constricted_, the target is _Restrained_ and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

feature.name: Life Leech - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to force a _Vulnerable_ or _Restrained_ target within Melee range to mark **1d4-1** HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

feature.name: Sleep Toxin - Reaction
feature.text: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to make them _Vulnerable_ until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

motives_and_tactics: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass
name: Lamia

description: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.

feature.name: Doppel-Dangler - Action
feature.text: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler's head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. **Mark a Stress** to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

feature.name: Entice - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler's head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

feature.name: Gulp - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes **3d6** physical damage and is _Swallowed_. While _Swallowed_, the target is _Restrained_ and takes **3d6** physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

motives_and_tactics: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk
name: Lamplight Beguiler

description: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Riddle Me This - Passive
feature.text: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

feature.name: Winged - Passive
feature.text: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

feature.name: Pouncing Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **3d20+6** physical damage, and the target becomes _Shaky_ until they spend a Hope. While _Shaky_, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

feature.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes **3d8** physical damage and becomes _Restrained_ until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

feature.name: Locking Jaws - Reaction
feature.text: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

motives_and_tactics: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick
name: Manticore

description: The sovereign ruler of a nation, wreathed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.

feature.name: Execute Them! - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

feature.name: Crownsguard - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **mark a Stress** to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

feature.name: Casus Belli - Reaction
feature.text: _Long-Term Countdown (8)_. **Spend a Fear** to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain **1d4** Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy
name: Monarch

description: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.

feature.name: Horde (2d6+2) - Passive
feature.text: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d6+2** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Swell Ranks - Action
feature.text: Once per scene, **mark any number of Stress** to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

feature.name: Overwhelm - Reaction
feature.text: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against the attacker.

motives_and_tactics: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow
name: Night Children

description: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.

feature.name: Walk Between Worlds - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

feature.name: Pleasure and Pain - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a **d8**. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain **1d6** Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

motives_and_tactics: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires
name: Pain Priest

description: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.

feature.name: Purifying Aura - Passive
feature.text: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix's Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

feature.name: Fireseed - Reaction
feature.text: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

feature.name: Resurrection - Evolution
feature.text: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals **3d4** direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

motives_and_tactics: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame
name: Phoenix

description: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.

feature.name: Only a Rumor - Passive
feature.text: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can't be located or targeted.

feature.name: Wall of Water - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take **3d10** physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

motives_and_tactics: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully
name: Plesiosaurus

description: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Bird of Prey - Passive
feature.text: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

feature.name: Here Comes the Boom - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against **1d4+1** targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take **3d12** magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take **3d8** physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Crushing Grasp - Reaction
feature.text: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark **1d4** Stress and _Restraining_ them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

feature.name: Nest Warden - Evolution
feature.text: When the Roc's eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:

feature.name: Wrathful - Passive
feature.text: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

feature.name: Electrifying Aura - Passive
feature.text: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark **1d4** Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar
name: Roc

description: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.

feature.name: Venomous Tail Stinger - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes **3d10+2** physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

feature.name: Devour - Action
feature.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm _Swallows_ the target. While _Swallowed_, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

feature.name: Hungry, Not Stupid - Reaction
feature.text: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or _Swallows_ a creature, roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

motives_and_tactics: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends
name: Sandwyrm

description: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.

feature.name: Fiendish Nature - Passive
feature.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

feature.name: Impersonate - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Turn Invisible - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make the Fiend _Hidden_ until they make an action roll or take damage.

feature.name: Backhanded Guidance - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can **mark a Stress** to add **1d6** to the result of their Fear Die.

feature.name: Exposed! (Phase Change) - Reaction
feature.text: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

motives_and_tactics: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal
name: Shapeshifting Fiend

description: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Fiendish Resistance - Passive
feature.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

feature.name: Demonic Rage - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

feature.name: Hall of Mirrors - Action
feature.text: **Mark 2 Stress** to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

feature.name: Flash Claw - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take **3d20** magic damage.

feature.name: Mind Games - Reaction
feature.text: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

motives_and_tactics: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport
name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed

description: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Momentum - Passive
feature.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Ball Lightning - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Titan conjure **1d4** spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes **4d6** magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

feature.name: Storm Bringer - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **3d12** magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

feature.name: Thunderclap - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

motives_and_tactics: Erupt violently, wait, watch
name: Storm Titan

description: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.

feature.name: From Above - Passive
feature.text: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal **3d12+3** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

feature.name: Blade of the Forest - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to **3d4** + the target's Major threshold.

feature.name: Thorny Armor - Reaction
feature.text: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to deal **1d10+5** physical damage to the attacker.

motives_and_tactics: Isolate, maneuver, protect the forest, weed the unwelcome
name: Stag Knight

description: A sturdy animate old-growth tree.

feature.name: Just a Tree - Passive
feature.text: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become _Hidden_, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

feature.name: Seed Barrage - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take **2d10+5** physical damage.

feature.name: Take Root - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to _Root_ the Treant in place. The Treant is _Restrained_ while _Rooted_, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches
name: Oak Treant

description: A small, sentient tree sapling.

feature.name: Minion (6) - Passive
feature.text: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Blend in, preserve the forest, pummel, surround
name: Treant Sapling

description: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.

feature.name: Celestial Lance - Passive
feature.text: The Unicorn's standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

feature.name: Healing Touch - Action
feature.text: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. **Mark any number of Stress** to clear an equal number of the ally's HP.

feature.name: Protective Aura - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

feature.name: Teleport - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

motives_and_tactics: Keep evil at bay, protect the sacred, sense emotions and intent
name: Unicorn

description: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Look into My Eyes - Passive
feature.text: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain **1d4** Fear.

feature.name: Feed on Followers - Action
feature.text: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

feature.name: The Hunt Is On - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to summon **1d4** Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

feature.name: Lifesuck - Reaction
feature.text: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a **d8**. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

motives_and_tactics: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate
name: Head Vampire

description: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.

feature.name: Horde (2d6) - Passive
feature.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **2d6** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Blinding Multitude - Passive
feature.text: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

feature.name: Bloodsuckers - Reaction
feature.text: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

motives_and_tactics: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease
name: Vampire Bat Swarm

description: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator's smile.

feature.name: Draining Bite - Action
feature.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **5d4** physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

feature.name: Mistform - Reaction
feature.text: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can **spend a Fear** to take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Bite, charm, deceive, feed, intimidate
name: Vampire

description: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Midnight Heart - Passive
feature.text: _Long-Term Countdown (6)._ The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it's destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Unleash Hellfire - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure **1d4** bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals **3d6** magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

feature.name: Resurgence - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can **spend a Fear** to clear a HP or a Stress.

feature.name: Melt into Shadow - Reaction
feature.text: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can **spend a Fear** to roll a **d6**. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range.

feature.name: Hellwing - Evolution
feature.text: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the "On Crimson Wings" and "Bloodbath" features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack: **Claws:** Close | 3d12+6 phy

feature.name: On Crimson Wings - Passive
feature.text: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

feature.name: Bloodbath - Reaction
feature.text: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing **3d10** magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take **3d6** magic damage.

motives_and_tactics: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power
name: Vampire Lord

description: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.

feature.name: Blocking Shield - Passive
feature.text: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

feature.name: Lock Up - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is _Restrained_ within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While _Restrained_, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

motives_and_tactics: Carry away, entrap, protect, pummel
name: Vault Guardian Gaoler

description: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.

feature.name: Kinetic Slam - Passive
feature.text: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

feature.name: Box In - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they're within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

feature.name: Mana Bolt - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d8+20** magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't knocked back.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect
name: Vault Guardian Sentinel

description: A massive living turret with reinforced armor and twelve piston-driven mechanical legs.

feature.name: Slow Firing - Passive
feature.text: When you spotlight the Turret and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

feature.name: Mark Target - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to _Mark_ a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the _Marked_ target becomes _Hidden_. While the target is _Marked_, their Evasion is halved.

feature.name: Concentrate Fire - Reaction
feature.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can **mark a Stress** to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

feature.name: Detonation - Reaction
feature.text: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **3d20** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

motives_and_tactics: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect
name: Vault Guardian Turret

description: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.

feature.name: Join or Die - Passive
feature.text: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn't reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

feature.name: Entangling Entrails - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, _Restraining_ them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

feature.name: Lifesuck - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a _Restrained_ target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

motives_and_tactics: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half
name: Viscera Sucker

description: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.

feature.name: Greater Specter - Passive
feature.text: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

feature.name: Spooky - Passive
feature.text: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Nightmare Shroud - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, _Shrouding_ the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While _Shrouded,_ the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the _Shrouded_ target.

motives_and_tactics: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads
name: Whisper Wraith

description: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.

feature.name: Double Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

feature.name: Terrifying Shriek - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are _Terrified_ until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While _Terrified_, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

feature.name: Clutch - Reaction
feature.text: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Wyvern _Restrain_ the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While _Restrained_ in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

motives_and_tactics: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air
name: Wyvern

description: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Intimidating - Passive
feature.text: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

feature.name: Flame Breath - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **4d8+3** magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.

feature.name: Eruption - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming _Vulnerable_ until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

feature.name: Blazing Scales - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Slash and Burn - Reaction
feature.text: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can **mark a Stress** to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

motives_and_tactics: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take
name: Young Fire Dragon

description: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Rend and Crush - Passive
feature.text: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

feature.name: No Hope - Passive
feature.text: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

feature.name: Blizzard Breath - Action
feature.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. feature.name: Avalanche - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Frozen Scales - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become _Chilled_ until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are _Chilled_, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

feature.name: Momentum - Reaction
feature.text: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul
name: Young Ice Dragon

description: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.

feature.name: Dance of Death - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you **spend a Fear**.

feature.name: Beam of Decay - Action
feature.text: **Mark 2 Stress** to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d20+12** magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark **2 Stress** and becomes _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

feature.name: Open the Gates of Death - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

feature.name: Not Today, My Dears - Reaction
feature.text: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can **spend a Fear** to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

feature.name: Your Life Is Mine - Reaction
feature.text: _Countdown (Loop 2d6)_. When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal **2d10+6** direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then **clears a number of Stress or HP** equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

motives_and_tactics: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day, resurrect
name: Arch-Necromancer

description: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.

feature.name: Toxic Skin - Passive
feature.text: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

feature.name: Bear Hug - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is _Grappled_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While _Grappled_, the target is _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_.

feature.name: Crunch! - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to deal **4d12** direct physical damage to a creature _Grappled_ by the Abomination.

feature.name: Tongue Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

feature.name: Burrowing Leechpoles - Reaction
feature.text: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in **2d4** leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

motives_and_tactics: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab
name: Cephilith Abomination

description: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey's skull, bathing the victim's brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.

feature.name: Minion (12) - Passive
feature.text: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Comatize - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC's brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Climb, feed, hatch, numb, scuttle
name: Cephilith Hatchling

description: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.

feature.text: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

feature.name: Sacrifice Self - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

motives_and_tactics: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge
name: Cephilith Novitiate

description: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.

feature.name: Psychic Blast - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **2d10+5** direct magic damage. Targets who fail take **4d10+10** direct magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until spotlighted.

feature.name: Cerebral Incursion - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a _Vulnerable_ target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target's ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark **1d6** Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

feature.name: Telekinetic Grasp - Reaction
feature.text: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **mark a Stress** to _Restrain_ the target until they spend a Hope.

motives_and_tactics: Break the unbelievers' minds, prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan's arrival, sing its praises
name: Cephilith Priest

description: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.

feature.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive

feature.name: Summon Worshippers - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to summon **1d4** Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

motives_and_tactics: Call and consume followers, corrupt reality, invade the Mortal Realm, spew forth chaos
name: Cephilith Titan

description: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Many Mouths - Action

feature.name: Summon Tormentors - Action
feature.text: Once per day, **spend 2 Fear** to summon **2d4** Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

feature.name: Ominous Knowledge - Reaction
feature.text: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

feature.name: Vengeful Fate - Reaction
feature.text: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal **2d10+4** physical damage.

motives_and_tactics: Change environment, condemn, dishearten, toss aside
name: Oracle of Doom

description: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.

feature.name: Chaotic Form - Passive
feature.text: When the Abomination attacks, roll **2d4** and use the result as their attack modifier.

feature.name: Disorienting Presence - Passive
feature.text: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Reality Quake - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become _Unstuck_ from reality until the end of the scene. When an _Unstuck_ target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

feature.name: Unreal Form - Reaction
feature.text: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by **1d20**. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

motives_and_tactics: Demolish, devour, undermine
name: Outer Realms Abomination

description: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.

feature.name: Will-Shattering Touch - Passive
feature.text: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

feature.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

motives_and_tactics: Confuse, distract, overwhelm
name: Outer Realms Corrupter

description: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.

feature.name: Minion (13) - Passive
feature.text: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate
name: Outer Realms Thrall

description: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.

feature.name: Ill Omen - Passive
feature.text: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

feature.name: Witch Barrier - Passive
feature.text: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

feature.name: Voice Mimicry - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

feature.name: Nightmare Stare - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Owl Witch _Afflict_ a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While _Afflicted_, the target can't clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the _Afflicted_ creature.

feature.name: Visions of a Violent End - Reaction
feature.text: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark **1d4** Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

motives_and_tactics: Consume essence, curse, predict death
name: Owl Witch

description: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Fearsome - Passive
feature.text: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Melting Breath - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d12+10** magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

feature.name: Volcanic Fissure - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take **4d8+5** magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes **4d8+5** magic damage.

feature.name: Hot-Blooded - Reaction
feature.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon's blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they mark **1d4** HP.

motives_and_tactics: Crack the earth, melt, protect treasure
name: Ruby Dragon

description: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.

feature.name: Minion (12) - Passive
feature.text: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Shadow Grapple - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform
name: Severed Shadow

description: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.

feature.name: Relentless (4) - Passive
feature.text: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Elemental Archon - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to roll a **d4**. Adonix activates the corresponding effect: 1. _Fire Beam._ Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam's path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage. 2. _Thunderclap._ All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become _Vulnerable_ until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated. 3. _Lightning Bolt._ Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing **4d8** magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets. 4. _Ice Storm._ Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark **1d4** Stress and become _Restrained_ until they spend a Hope to escape.

feature.name: Alpha to Omega - Evolution
feature.text: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You gain a Fear for each Hope lost in this way. Adonix gains the following features in this form:

feature.name: Forsaken - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.

feature.name: Armageddon - Reaction
feature.text: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a **d6**. On a result of 5-6, each PC must make a death move.

motives_and_tactics: Establish dominion, exile from reality, float above it all, speak into being
name: Supreme Demiurge Adonix

description: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Time Looper - Passive
feature.text: _Countdown (Loop 2d6)._ When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

feature.name: Move Between Moments - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

feature.name: Instant Rewind - Reaction
feature.text: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can **spend a Fear** to reroll the die.

feature.name: Invert Polarity - Reaction
feature.text: Up to three times per scene, you can **spend a Fear** to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can't be used to alter a critical success.

motives_and_tactics: Repair the timeline, seek out temporal heretics, serve the Lords of Continuity
name: Temporal Enforcer

description: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Flying - Passive
feature.text: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

feature.name: Obsidian Scales - Passive
feature.text: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

feature.name: Avalanche Tail - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **4d6+4** physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and _Vulnerable_ until their next roll with Hope.

feature.name: Dive-Bomb - Action
feature.text: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, **mark a Stress** to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **2d10+6** physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

feature.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change) - Reaction
feature.text: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

motives_and_tactics: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate
name: Obsidian Predator

description: Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.

feature.name: Relentless (3) - Passive
feature.text: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Cracked Scales - Passive
feature.text: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of **d6s** equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Shattering Might - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes **4d8+1** physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

feature.name: Eruption - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d6+6** physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

feature.name: Volcanic Breath - Reaction
feature.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a **d10**. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10+4** physical damage, mark **1d4 Stress**, and are _Vulnerable_ until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Lava Splash - Reaction
feature.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from an attack within Very Close range, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals **2d10+4** direct physical damage to the attacker.

feature.name: Ashen Vengeance (Phase Change) - Reaction
feature.text: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

motives_and_tactics: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel Invaders, reposition
name: Molten Scourge

description: No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the lava settles, it's ground to ash like the dragon's past foes.

feature.name: Relentless (4) - Passive
feature.text: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Cornered - Passive
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

feature.name: Injured Wings - Passive
feature.text: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

feature.name: Ashes to Ashes - Passive
feature.text: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

feature.name: Desperate Rampage - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take **2d20+2** physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Ashen Cloud - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

feature.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing - Action
feature.text: _Countdown (1d12)_. **Spend a Fear** to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10+10** physical damage and are _Restrained_ by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

motives_and_tactics: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed
name: Ashen Tyrant

description: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.

feature.name: Segmented - Passive
feature.text: The Water Mother's body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra **1d10** damage.

feature.name: Eat the World - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

feature.name: Constrict - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take **4d8+8** physical damage and are temporarily _Restrained_. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can **mark a Stress** to force all targets _Restrained_ by the Water Mother to mark a HP.

feature.name: Venom Surge - Reaction
feature.text: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Vulnerable_ until the end of the scene.

motives_and_tactics: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water
name: Water Mother

description: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master's will than as individual beings.

feature.name: Minion (13) - Passive
feature.text: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

feature.name: Venomous Bite - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal **4d4+4** physical damage and _Poison_ the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While _Poisoned,_ the target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

feature.name: Group Attack - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

motives_and_tactics: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm
name: Wyrmfiend

description: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they're furious, hungry, and stupid.

feature.name: Horde (2d6+5) - Passive
feature.text: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d6+5** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Ravenous - Reaction
feature.text: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

feature.name: Overwhelm - Reaction
feature.text: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

motives_and_tactics: Consume, shred, swarm
name: Wyrmlings

description: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.

feature.name: Relentless (X) - Passive
feature.text: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

feature.name: Collateral Damage - Passive
feature.text: Xero's movement can't be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero's path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

feature.name: Gigaton Stomp - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes **4d12** physical damage and is _Restrained_ until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take **4d12** physical damage as they land.

feature.name: Power Slide - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

feature.name: Radioactive Breath - Action
feature.text: **Spend a Fear** to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can **spend this token** and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **4d12+12** direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can't use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

feature.name: Regeneration - Action
feature.text: Up to three times per scene, **spend any number of Fear** to clear an equal number of HP.

motives_and_tactics: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements
name: Xero the Castle Killer

description: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.

feature.name: Terrifying - Passive
feature.text: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

feature.name: Fearsome Presence - Passive
feature.text: PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

feature.name: Perfect Strike - Action
feature.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are _Vulnerable_ until their next rest.

feature.name: Skilled Opportunist - Reaction
feature.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can **spend a Fear** to add the Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

motives_and_tactics: Consume, hound, maim, terrify
name: Perfected Zombie

description: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.

feature.name: Horde (2d6+5) - Passive
feature.text: When the Legion has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d6+5** physical damage instead.

feature.name: Unyielding - Passive
feature.text: The Legion has resistance to physical damage.

feature.name: Relentless (2) - Passive
feature.text: The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

feature.name: Overwhelm - Reaction
feature.text: When the Legion takes Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

motives_and_tactics: Consume brain, shred flesh, surround
name: Zombie Legion
